title: 第347章 女魔头回来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你们真以为吃定我了不成！”韩林一手扶着树干，双眼微微一眯，缓缓站直了身子。

众散修见状，顿时心头一凛，瞬间有些底气不足了起来。

毕竟刚才韩林大杀四方的场景，他们是有目共睹的，而且好几人都是被韩林瞬杀。

尽管此时韩林看起来已经不行了，但谁也不想成为下一个倒霉蛋。

“姓韩的，你还想吓唬谁呢，既然你不肯自废丹田，那老夫就来帮你好了！”

那名黑袍老者再次站了出来，说着果真出手，幻化出一群黑鸦哗啦啦地朝韩林扑了过来。

“黑鸦上人！”

见到漫天黑鸦出现，周围的散修顿时认出此人来历，不由脸色骤变地向边上闪去。

此人可是二级海域赫赫有名的邪修，死在他手里的筑基强者不下三十人，甚至还越阶杀过一名筑基后期强者，让其名扬碧空诸岛。

这些黑鸦速度并不快，但一路上呱呱叫唤，吵得人心烦意乱，让本就精神恍惚的韩林愈发头疼。

“找死。”

关键时刻，韩林心头一狠，大喝一声：“二蛋子，出来！”

同时右手往天上一甩，顿时一团猩红之气脱手而出，在半空中显现出一只拖着长长尾巴的怪兽。

此兽身长两三丈，通体暗红色，大虾一般的前身，蜈蚣的身躯，还长着四只铁画银钩般的细足，双钳似火、獠牙巨口。

相比于从前，此刻的虾蜈怪，看起来更加的凶恶了。

它刚一现身，就厉啸一声，对着半空张嘴一喷，顿时大片猩红色毒云在空中汇聚。

无数黑鸦怪叫着冲进毒云之中，结果瞬间就被腐蚀成空气，消失得无影无踪。

“这是什么妖兽！”

见到此幕，所有人都忍不住地吃了一惊。

“快闪开！”

忽然，有人惊叫一声，随后众人就如同兔子一般弹跳而起，向四面八方飞射出去。

同一时间，吴二蛋张开大嘴，一团覆盖一两里的巨型毒云呼地落在众人原本站立之处。

转瞬间，地面的绿草就滋滋冒烟，腐烂不堪。

众散修回头见到此景，全都吓了一大跳，庆幸自己跑得快！

而就在众人躲避的同时，韩林大袖一挥，飞羽剑显现而出，跳上去对着半空的吴二蛋一伸手将其收回药园，然后头也不回地冲天而起，向远处飞去。

“快，拦住他！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You really think you can defeat me!" Han Lin held onto the tree trunk with one hand, narrowed his eyes slightly, and slowly stood up straight.

Seeing this, all the casual cultivators felt their hearts tremble, and instantly felt a little less confident.

After all, they had witnessed the scene where Han Lin was killing everyone just now, and several people were killed instantly by Han Lin.

Although Han Lin seemed to be in despair at this time, no one wanted to be the next unlucky guy.

"Han, who else are you trying to scare? Since you refuse to destroy your Dantian, I'll help you!"

The old man in black robe stood up again, and as he said that, he took action, transformed into a group of black crows and rushed toward Han Lin.

"Master Black Crow!"

Seeing the black crows appearing in the sky, the casual cultivators around him immediately recognized this person's origins, and their expressions suddenly changed and they ducked to the side.

This person is a well-known evil cultivator in the second-level sea area. No fewer than thirty foundation-building experts have died in his hands. He even killed a late-stage foundation-building powerhouse beyond his rank, making him famous on the Blue Sky Islands.

These black crows were not very fast, but they croaked and screamed along the way, which made people upset and made Han Lin, who was already in a trance, even more headache.

"Seeking death."

At the critical moment, Han Lin was heartbroken and shouted: "Erdanzi, come out!"

At the same time, he flicked his right hand to the sky, and a ball of scarlet energy suddenly came out of his hand, and a monster with a long tail appeared in mid-air.

This beast is two to three feet long, with a dark red body, a prawn-like front body, a centipede-like body, four thin feet like iron-painted silver hooks, fire-like pair of pincers, and a huge mouth with fangs.

Compared to before, the shrimp centipede looked even more sinister now.

As soon as it appeared, it roared sharply, opened its mouth and sprayed into the air, and suddenly a large scarlet poisonous cloud gathered in the sky.

Countless black crows screamed and rushed into the poisonous cloud. As a result, they were instantly corroded into air and disappeared without a trace.

"What kind of monster is this!"

Seeing this scene, everyone couldn't help being surprised.

"Get out of the way!"

Suddenly, someone screamed, and then everyone jumped up like rabbits and flew in all directions.

At the same time, Wu Erdan opened his mouth, and a giant poisonous cloud covering a mile or two landed on the ground where everyone was standing.

In an instant, the green grass on the ground became smoky and rotten.

When all the cultivators turned around and saw this scene, they were all frightened. They were thankful that they ran fast!

While everyone was dodging, Han Lin waved his sleeves and the Feiyu Sword appeared. He jumped up to Wu Erdan in mid-air and stretched out his hand to take it back to the medicine garden. Then he soared into the sky and flew into the distance without looking back.

"Quick, stop him!"
